mapper.sql: i.id, i.kind, i.display_name, i.stored_name, i.original_name, i.content_type, i.size_bytes, i.url, i.uploaded_by, i.created_at, i.category_id, i.sub_category_id, c.name AS category_name, sc.name AS sub_category_name, u.name AS uploader_name
FROM images i LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = i.category_id LEFT JOIN categories sc ON sc.id = i.sub_category_id LEFT JOIN admin_users u ON u.id = i.uploaded_by

where.if: AND (LOWER(i.original_name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(COALESCE(i.display_name, '')) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%')))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO images (kind, display_name, stored_name, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, url, uploaded_by, category_id, sub_category_id) VALUES (#{kind}, #{displayName}, #{storedName}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{url}, #{uploadedBy}, #{categoryId}, #{subCategoryId})
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT category_id AS id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM images WHERE category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category_id
SELECT sub_category_id AS id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM images WHERE sub_category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sub_category_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM images WHERE category_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM images WHERE kind = #{kind}
mapper.update: UPDATE images SET display_name = #{displayName} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE images SET category_id = #{categoryId}, sub_category_id = #{subCategoryId} WHERE id = #{id}
